policy: A certified block passes all three bars in scripts/certify_block.py. Control-delete (bar 3) is the one that counts: the block's tests must go RED when its entry method is gutted to a plausible success. New certifications must name a real fixture exercised by the tests. include_in_ci entries run on every CI push.

blocks.fixture: PIL image rendered in-test (real pixel payload)
real Python source strings executed through the restricted in-process exec, plus a fake sandbox-runner HTTP transport for the isolated path
an injected in-process cache client, round-tripped under real scope_key() tenant/project/source-class keys
real files written to and read back from a tmp_path drive root, plus ../ escape attempts
an RSA-2048 key generated in-test; a real RS256 service-account JWT is minted and its header/claims decoded

blocks.failing_bar: BAR3 FAIL: suite stayed GREEN on a plausible-success gut (tests prove nothing about OneDriveBlock.process payloads). tests/blocks/test_onedrive.py asserts only the UniversalBlock envelope keys, which execute() supplies regardless of what process() returns.
BAR3 FAIL: suite stayed GREEN on a plausible-success gut (tests prove nothing about SearchBlock.process payloads). tests/blocks/test_search.py asserts only the UniversalBlock envelope keys.

BAR3 FAIL: suite stayed GREEN on a plausible-success gut (tests prove nothing about TranslateBlock.process payloads). tests/blocks/test_translate.py asserts only the UniversalBlock envelope keys; no test reads result['result']['translated'].
BAR3 FAIL: suite stayed GREEN on a plausible-success gut (tests prove nothing about WebBlock.process payloads). tests/blocks/test_web.py asserts only the UniversalBlock envelope keys.

BAR3 FAIL: suite stayed GREEN on a plausible-success gut (tests prove nothing about LearningEngineBlock.process payloads). No learning_engine test calls process() or execute() at all -- every one reaches into _save_state/_update_credibility/_store directly, so the block's dispatcher is entirely uncovered.

BAR3 NOT RUNNABLE: the Store has no test for this block. tests/blocks/test_inbound_webhook.py covers app/blocks/inbound_webhook.py, a different block. app/blocks/webhook.py (outbound send/register/trigger) has zero coverage.
